programs.name: Accounting and Software Applications
programs.focus: Combines traditional and digital accounting with financial software applications and accounting information systems. Objective: prepare graduates to prepare and analyze financial statements, use accounting software, and understand digital transformation in business. Key study areas: financial, intermediate and cost accounting; computerized governmental accounting; accounting information systems; financial planning and analysis; statistical analytics; financial software applications.
programs.careers: Accounting, auditing, financial analysis, taxation, banking, accounting information systems, and financial software companies.

programs.name: Digital Marketing and E-Management
programs.focus: Integrates marketing and business administration concepts with digital marketing tools, e-commerce, and management through digital platforms. Objective: prepare professionals to manage digital campaigns, analyze customer behavior, manage online platforms, and develop modern marketing strategies. Key study areas: digital marketing, e-commerce, platform and content management, business and data analytics, consumer behavior, e-management, and development of digital campaigns and strategies.
programs.careers: Digital marketing, social media management, e-commerce, market analysis, content management, digital customer service, and electronic project management.
